author: fxeyes
text:
I think an IM or chat is helpful just to have a group of people to
connect with on a daily basis and get some motivation. I'm a pretty
introverted person but there are days where I struggle to stay motivated
 because this can be such a lonely and brutal thing to do day in and day
 out; especially after a bad day. Although I can see some people just
getting lazy and looking for trade ideas on the IMs, instead of studying
 the materials themselves.

author: CanadoughPipKiller
text:
I agree. I would love to have this and I feel that the good would
outweigh the bad. I mean if we are worried about losing anything just
post up the chat logs here for everyone to catch up on later. It can be
really discouraging a lot of the time, feeling all alone, not knowing
where to focus all your attention. I spend countless hours trying to
learn this stuff every week and not sure if Im getting any better. There
 is a ton of really helpful info on the forum but as people have said
before its a little all over the place and not always so clear in how to
 go about putting it together. I think people who are still finding
their way are going to be less likely to make a thread or forum post in
fear of looking stupid. With a daily chat I feel like their would be a
whole lot more discussion and it would bring everyone together more.
Rather than everyone sitting staring at their screens all day all alone.
 I feel like as everyone becomes more well rounded in the material,
there would actually be more threads on the forum, as everyone is going
to feel that much more comfortable with the material and the techniques.
 Anyways those are just my thoughts. I want whats best for RTM and will
still love this community whatever that is. But like I said I spend
hours and hours working on this stuff every single day, missing out on
time with my family, just to try to provide a living, I would much
rather be in discussion with others in the same boat, rather then
sitting in isolation, Im not going to be posting up every little thought
 and idea that I have all day long on the forum.

author: nsikandar
text:
I feel the same sometimes Canadough. I have moments of doubt and lose hope. Like you I also trust If's judgement.

I am just so humbled by our Chief Cook and Bottle Cleaner's patience and generosity with all of us.

Anyway, back to study

author: Atari
text:
We are our greatest enemy. The inner voice that is between our ears
manages to take over all the time, bombarding us with excuses, with
negative thoughts, shoot us down, telling us we cannot make
it....etc..... Unless, we are aware that it is the inner voice talking
and not us, then we can conquer and shut it up for the time being. It
will want to come back and it is our job to notice it and shut it up
again. When you catch it and shut it up, eventually, it will lose its
grip on your mind. It is not gone, but it loses its power over you.

Yes, RTM is a puzzle and you will have to put the puzzle together
yourself here. Trading is not easy, but it is simple, once you get it.
 If trading is easy, then your garbage collector will be doing it too
and you will not have anyone to pick up your garbage every week or day
from your house.

If Thomas Edison gave up on the 100th trial of creating a light bulb, do
 you think we will have a light bulb today? Thomas Edison had more than
 1000 trial and error before you was able to invent the light bulb. If
 Steve Job and his team decided it was too difficult to create an
Ipod/Ipad after months working on it, do you think we will have an
Ipod/Ipad today.

Success takes hard work and a spirit not to quit, no matter what
obstacles are in front of us. You fall down, you get up, you fall down,
 you get up, you fall down you get up. We all forget that we are all
champions when we were a baby. We all forgot that. Remember, when you
were a baby learning how to stand and walk. When you fell down, you got
 right back up and try again and again and again, until you were able to
 walk and then run after. You did not tell yourself then, when you were
 a baby that it was too hard to learn to walk. You just got right back
up and went at it until you got it. What makes you any difference now?
 It is your inner voice that is between your ears. You are listening
to the negative messages it is feeding you. That is the difference.

If you truly want to become a trader, then you must realize that and
conquer it. Here is a question for you to ponder at. "If trading is
the only thing I am committed to do, what would I do differently today?"

Let me give you a story... A long time ago, there was a war between 2
countries. The captain was given 100 men to sail on his wooden ship to
the enemy shores and take over that area. The enemy had 1000 men
waiting for them. As soon as the captain landed and his men disembarked
the wooden ship, the captain burned the ship. His men were left with
the message, 'you can either choose to die here or defeat your enemy and
 live. His men did not have the comfort of retreating back to their
ship for it has been burned. So either die at the enemy shore or defeat
the 1000 men and take over and live. His 100 men at the end defeated
the 1000.enemies.

So if you come to RTM with that kind of mentality, your chances of success is much greater.

You all know that we do have RTM Academy, which we put the puzzle
together for you so that you don't have to spend thousands of hours
trying to figure it out yourself. Even inside the academy, the students
 there have to roll up their sleeves and work hard on the lessons and
assignments and learn how to think critically and apply their analytical
 skills. While the price tag may cause some of you to shy away from it, I
 can for certain say that the value you will get from the Academy will
easily overshadow the price tag once you graduate from the Academy.
